expectedBehavior: Two clean, sequential native linux/amd64 builds from the accepted pinned inputs produce byte-identical image configuration, history, and complete rootfs layer identity.
observedBehavior: The final evidence-informed pair retained identical configuration and history but produced different image IDs and different complete rootfs layer identity. No native Bun image or digest was accepted.

reproduction.repeatability: The bounded continuation pair remained non-identical after the determinism changes derived from the earlier pair.

causalBoundary.initiatingTrigger: A clean native Bun rebuild materializes retained generated build state.
causalBoundary.maskingCondition: Comparing image configuration or history alone masks the divergence because both were equal; complete rootfs layer comparison exposes it.
causalBoundary.visibleSymptom: The two candidate images have distinct image IDs and rootfs layer identities, so the pair cannot be accepted.
causalBoundary.earliestObservedDivergence: Generated Ninja, Cargo, ccache, and metadata paths retained different bytes or metadata between builds.
causalBoundary.disconfirmingCheck: If the complete rootfs identities had matched after forcing rustc metadata ordering with -Zthreads=1, the determinism explanation would have been rejected. They did not match.

disposition.perArchitectureManifestProvenance: blocked; historical ARM64 image remains bound and honestly labelled
disposition.admission: excluded from non-Bun source sweep; blocks atomic 27/27 cohort admission
disposition.requiredAction: Do not admit or fabricate a Bun native digest. Resolve bun-image-blocker before authorizing another bounded determinism probe and pair.
